Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of θέμις (statute; from the base of G5087); illegal; by implication, flagitious:--abominable, unlawful thing.
BiblicalUsage: Peter told Cornelius it was unlawful for a Jew to keep company with a man of another nation, and he wrote that believers had already spent enough time in the abominable idolatries of their past life. The word means what the law forbids.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the wall Peter thought the law built was the very wall God was pulling down, because Christ had made the two one.
